name: application-trend-sparkbar-row
title: Trend Sparkbar Row
description: Table with an inline mini bar-series column for compact per-row trends, driven by a typed rows/values prop contract.
useWhen: A data table needs a compact visual trend indicator alongside each row's numeric value.
Users benefit from scanning many rows' recent trajectories at once without opening a chart per row.
The trend is a supporting visual cue, with the actual change percentage stated in a nearby column.
avoidWhen: You need a single prominent trend visualization on its own — use the Metric Sparkline Card, which is a standalone KPI tile, not an in-row indicator.
Precise value-by-value reading matters — a small bar series can't substitute for a full chart with axes.
The table already has too many columns — an inline trend column competes for space with primary data.
responsiveBehavior: The table scrolls horizontally on narrow viewports via its wrapping overflow container; bar heights stay fixed in pixels so the sparkbar column keeps a consistent compact width.
accessibility: Each sparkbar series is marked aria-hidden since it is a decorative summary — the adjacent Change column states the same trend in text.
Bar color (green/red/gray) reinforces but never replaces the numeric change label, which always carries a +/- sign.
Column headers use scope='col' so assistive technology can associate each cell with its column when navigating.

variants.title: Trend Sparkbar Row
variants.description: Product table with an inline 7-bar trend series per row, a units-sold column, and a color-coded percentage change column.
accessibility: The sparkbar series is aria-hidden; the numeric Change column is the accessible source of trend direction.

variants.title: Trend Sparkbar Row (Dark)
variants.description: Sparkbar trend table adapted for dark surfaces with the same in-row bar series and change-column structure.
accessibility: Bar colors and the change-column text must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
